title: unified-rollouts-probing-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflows
author: Maya Thompson
release_notes: Adds probing stage and enhanced auto-rollback workflows for canary/AB/shadow rollouts. Improves telemetry for rollback reasons and tracing across rollout stages. Includes e2e tests and stability guards. Backwards compatible with existing rollout configs.
description:
Context: We observed rollouts where brief upstream flakiness would flip a canary into a rollback even when subsequent probes recovered. This PR introduces a probing stage and quorum-driven probe evaluation to reduce false positive rollbacks, and ties the probing stage into the unified rollout authoring (canary / A-B / shadow) and auto-rollback engine.

Summary:
- Add a 'probing' stage that runs after initial traffic exposure and before committing a full traffic ramp. The probing stage collects probe slices across multiple metrics and time windows and requires a quorum to be met before considering the rollout healthy.
- Integrate probing with canary, A/B and shadow modes so probes can be run against production targets (canary), non-routing variants (shadow) or alternate routing weights (A/B).
- Expand rollback triggers: support composite metrics, configurable quorum, and per-rollout stability guards to avoid throttling on transient noise.
- Observability: emit rollout.probe.* and rollout.rollback.* metrics and add tracing tags (rollout.id, stage, reason). Dashboard and alert updates included.
- Tests: add unit tests for probe aggregation, and e2e harness tests that validate probe-driven commit vs rollback behavior across transient error injection.

Motivation: Reduce flappy rollbacks and give operators finer control over when a rollout should abort. For shadow traffic, probing provides an early signal without impacting user traffic. For canaries and A/B, probing prevents premature rollbacks from single-window anomalies.

What changed (high level):
- rollout/controller: add ProbingStage and probe evaluation engine (quorum, composite metrics, staleness windows).
- rollout/api: new optional `probing` config in rollout manifest (thresholds, quorum_size, window_seconds). Backwards compatible when omitted.
- autorollback/engine: consume probe results instead of raw SLO spikes; support composite metric expressions.
- telemetry: new metrics and tracing fields; map rollback.reason to a stable enum for dashboarding.
- tests/e2e: harness to inject transient errors and validate that probe quorum prevents unnecessary rollbacks.
- migration: small DB migration to add `last_probe_at` and `probe_status` columns (safe and optional).

Checklist: 
- [x] Add probing stage implementation
- [x] Integrate with canary/A-B/shadow logic
- [x] Add unit + e2e tests
- [x] Update dashboards and alerts
- [x] Add config docs and rollout examples

Notes: Default probing is opt-in for rollouts until the feature flag `rollout.probing_v1` is enabled in staging. We validated in staging with two internal services; observed a 35% reduction in spurious autorollbacks during transient upstream degradation.

reviews: Ethan Park: Overall design looks good. Requested changes: make quorum evaluation configurable per-rollout and increase default quorum window to 3 slices. Also asked for clearer enum mapping for rollback reasons.
Maya Thompson (author): Addressed by adding quorum_size + window_seconds to rollout manifest and added rollback_reason enum in telemetry. Added unit tests for quorum behavior.

Sofia Ramirez: Found a race in controller stop path when a rollout is deleted mid-probe. Requested a graceful-cancel change and a unit test. Maya Thompson: Fixed with context cancellation propagation and added test to probing_test.go.

merge_commit_message:
squash: unified-rollouts probing stage and probe-driven autorollback integration

Add probing stage and quorum-driven probe evaluation to reduce spurious rollbacks across canary/A-B/shadow rollouts. Includes tests, telemetry, and migration.
tests_added: unit tests for probing aggregation + e2e transient recovery harness
notes_for_ops: Feature disabled by default. Turn on feature flag rollout.probing_v1 in staging before enabling in production. Dashboards: observability/dashboards/rollouts-probing.json. Monitor rollout.probe.quorum_fail_rate and rollout.rollback.count for 48h after enabling.
changelog_entry: Added probing stage to unified rollouts: opt-in per-rollout config for quorum-based probe evaluation and enhanced auto-rollback safeguards. Improves stability of canary/A-B/shadow deployments.
risk_assessment: Low: default is opt-in and migration is additive. Potential risk is misconfigured quorum allowing slow detection; recommended to start with conservative thresholds.
